title: Late-Registration Penalty Computation for Title & Registration Services Orders
content:
When the state returns a Title & Registration Services packet as short because a late-registration penalty is due and states no amount on the return (a fee-shortage return of 0.00), the buyer pays the late-registration penalty, which is the standard penalty rate of twelve hundredths (0.12) applied to the sum of the title fee and the registration fee collected on the order, rounded half up to the cent and booked as its own entry that is not a schedule fee.

## Inputs

| Input | Record |
|---|---|
| title fee collected | the total of the state fee entries collected on the title order under the title fee |
| registration fee collected | the total of the state fee entries collected on the title order under the registration fee |
| penalty rate | 0.12 |

The rate is applied to the sum of the two fees first; the result is rounded half up to the cent only at the end.

## Worked examples (hypothetical orders)

1. A TX order collected a title fee of 33.00 and a registration fee of 51.75. The sum is 84.75; 0.12 of 84.75 is 10.17. The penalty is 10.17.
2. An FL order collected a title fee of 77.75 and a registration fee of 46.15. The sum is 123.90; 0.12 of 123.90 is 14.868, rounded half up to 14.87.
3. A Kestrel Title-Only Service order in GA collected a title fee of 18.00 and no registration fee. The sum is 18.00; the penalty is 2.16.
